##### Project general facts

Pearl House III by Imtiaz is an architectural gem that draws its inspiration from the timeless beauty of pearls, radiating luxury and sophistication in every graceful line. The building takes the organic shape of a pearl, with a sinuous, sculpted facade that makes it instantly captivating and gives residents a genuine sense of pride in coming home. Buyers can choose from beautifully appointed designer studios and designer one-bedroom apartments, each offering stunning panoramic views and a perfect sanctuary for entertaining guests or simply relaxing in a private oasis.

The amenity collection is wonderfully generous and designed to make everyday life feel effortless and enjoyable. A spectacular rooftop infinity pool and a luxury rooftop gym powered by the latest equipment sit alongside an inviting clubhouse and a stylish club room with a billiard table for relaxed evenings with friends. Families and professionals are equally well looked after with a state-of-the-art kids play area, a peaceful landscaped courtyard, a built-in office space for working from home, electric vehicle recharging stations and extra visitor parking.

Interiors are created by an award-winning designer and curated to deliver an elegant, sophisticated living space with the perfect touch of luxury and opulence. Every home is fully furnished with custom-made furniture and equipped with top-of-the-line appliances, elegant Italian tiles, premium sanitaryware and fixtures, a 65-inch television and a 24-inch iMac, while colour schemes inspired by nature create a tranquil and calming atmosphere. Clean lines, smart storage solutions and a warm neutral palette make each space feel open and inviting, and integrated smart home technology adds keyless entry, voice-controlled home automation and remote climate control for a truly seamless experience.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the heart of Dubai, Jumeirah Village Circle, or JVC, is a vibrant and rapidly growing community that captivates residents and visitors alike. This idyllic circular-shaped neighborhood is designed to offer a harmonious blend of modern living and natural beauty.

JVC's tree-lined streets, tranquil parks, and spacious villas and apartments make it a truly unique and welcoming place to call home. The community exudes a sense of peace and balance, providing a welcome escape from the hustle and bustle of city life, while still being conveniently located within Dubai.

Residents of JVC enjoy a host of amenities, including schools, shopping centers, parks, and recreational facilities, all thoughtfully integrated into the community's design. It's a place where families thrive, professionals find a convenient home, and nature lovers revel in the serene surroundings.
